name: Guppy
brief: Guppy: golden orange male with ornate turquoise and orange fan tail. Egg equivalent is an INTERNAL gestating embryo in a translucent membrane, not external laid eggs. Baby has short transparent tail and plain slender body; juvenile develops small colored fan; adult elaborate broad fan.

name: Neon tetra
brief: Neon tetra: slender turquoise luminous upper stripe, red restricted to rear half underneath, silver front belly. Tiny scattered translucent amber eggs; larva with yolk and transparent finfold; juvenile short developing stripe; adult fully crisp blue and posterior red.

name: Cardinal tetra
brief: Cardinal tetra: intense electric blue stripe and RED entire lower body from head to tail, distinct from neon tetra. Translucent tiny scattered eggs, yolk larva, juvenile with developing red length, adult mature continuous colors.

name: Betta
brief: Betta: wine-red and lavender male with flowing veil tail. Few pale eggs in tiny clear bubble nest; yolk larva, short-finned juvenile, mature deep crimson and periwinkle long flowing fins. Recognizable labyrinth fish anatomy.

name: Bronze corydoras
brief: Bronze corydoras: squat armored bottom catfish with bronze olive metallic flank, pale belly, barbels by downturned mouth and triangular dorsal fin. Small adhesive cream egg cluster; tiny translucent whiskered fry; juvenile developing armor and short barbels; mature bronze plates and strong barbels.

name: Zebra danio
brief: Zebra danio: slender silver gold fish with crisp longitudinal navy horizontal stripes extending into fins. Small scattered round eggs, nearly clear yolk larva, juvenile with broken developing stripes, adult full horizontal stripes and forked tail.

name: Harlequin rasbora
brief: Harlequin rasbora: copper salmon body with large BLACK TRIANGULAR WEDGE on rear flank, forked tail. Small adhesive pale eggs; transparent yolk larva; juvenile subtle small wedge; adult vivid copper and strong triangular patch.

name: Platy
brief: Platy: compact golden orange livebearer with red speckles, rounded tail, no sword. Egg equivalent is INTERNAL developing embryo in translucent membrane, never external laid eggs. Tiny plain short-finned fry, juvenile faint orange markings, stocky mature bright orange adult.

name: Freshwater angelfish
brief: Freshwater angelfish: silver gold vertically flattened diamond body, BLACK VERTICAL BARS, long dorsal and anal triangles, two fine pelvic streamers. Adhesive eggs in short neat row; wriggler larva; juvenile more round with short fins; adult tall diamond and long streamers. Not marine angelfish.

name: Bristlenose pleco
brief: Bristlenose pleco: brown gold speckled armored flattened bottom catfish, downturned sucker mouth, broad pectoral fins, mature male snout bristles. Orange adhesive egg cluster; yellow yolk fry with broad small head; juvenile mottled armor and minimal bristles; adult broad armored body and branching snout bristles. Side profile, head right.

name: Ocellaris clownfish
brief: Ocellaris clownfish Amphiprion ocellaris, vivid orange three white bands edged fine black, rounded fins. Attached amber elongated eggs in small clutch with embryo eyes; translucent slender larva with finfold and faint orange; juvenile developing bands and shorter fins; adult same identity and style as approved reference. This is life-stage coverage, preserve reference identity.

name: Royal gramma
brief: Royal gramma: purple HEAD and FRONT half, yellow REAR half and tail, small dark dorsal ocellus. Small clustered amber eggs; translucent slender larva; juvenile weak purple/yellow division; adult saturated purple head sharply transitioning yellow tail.

name: Firefish
brief: Firefish: pale ivory anterior, orange-red posterior and tail, very long narrow upright first dorsal spine. Tiny clear adhesive eggs, translucent slender larva, juvenile short dorsal spike and light pink tail, mature long dorsal pennant and flame red rear.

name: Yellow watchman goby
brief: Yellow watchman goby: mustard golden yellow stocky bottom goby with turquoise blue spots, broad cheek and large high-set eye, rounded fins and two dorsal fins. Small amber elongated egg clutch; transparent slender larva; juvenile pale lemon developing spots; mature golden blue-spotted goby.

name: Banggai cardinalfish
brief: Banggai cardinalfish: silver flattened body, three crisp black vertical bars, white polka dots on tall black fins, deeply forked trailing tail. Large orange egg cluster representing protected mouthbrood; tiny newly hatched fish with residual yolk and short fin tips; juvenile established bars but shorter rays; adult tall dramatic dotted fins.

name: Blue-green chromis
brief: Blue-green chromis: compact iridescent aqua turquoise damselfish, deep body, forked tail, no invented stripes. Small adhesive transparent eggs; clear slender yolk larva; juvenile pale narrow turquoise body; adult deeper emerald cyan iridescence.

name: Yellow tang
brief: Yellow tang: entirely brilliant lemon yellow disk-shaped fish, pointed snout, tall dorsal and anal fins, narrow tail peduncle with small white scalpel mark. Tiny pelagic transparent eggs; transparent elongated larval form; juvenile small translucent disk and emerging yellow; adult opaque bright yellow rounded disk.

name: Six-line wrasse
brief: Six-line wrasse: slender pink purple body with six narrow longitudinal orange lines, green tail, small eye-striped pointed head. Tiny transparent pelagic eggs; clear slender larva; juvenile faint incomplete orange lines; adult purple/orange six-lined sleek wrasse.

name: Tailspot blenny
brief: Tailspot blenny: small elongated rusty orange and blue gray benthic fish, blunt head with tiny eyebrow cirri, black ocellus at base of tail, long low dorsal. Small adhesive amber eggs, transparent slender larva, juvenile faint tail ocellus and stubby cirri, mature orange face blue-gray body and bold tailspot.

name: Marine betta
brief: Marine betta: dark midnight navy broad long fins with many pearl white spots and dark rear dorsal eyespot. Small amber egg cluster, delicate translucent larva, juvenile sparse large pale spots and short fins, adult elegant broad flowing navy fins and dense pearl spots.

name: Voidfin specter
brief: FICTIONAL Voidfin specter: deep violet angelfish-like tall silhouette, ghostly mint cyan translucent fin edging, visible dark eye, no extra heads or limbs. Fictional luminous violet embryo eggs, wispy transparent larva, juvenile violet short fins, adult tall violet cyan spectral fins.

name: Glassfang eel
brief: FICTIONAL Glassfang eel: very elongated glassy teal eel with pale yellow bioluminescent spine, small ivory fang at mouth, visible dark eye at right-facing head. Fictional translucent glowing mint eggs, ribbon larva with yolk, juvenile short narrow eel with tiny fang, mature long serpentine glass teal eel. Entire tail must fit each cell.

name: Garden zoanthids
brief: Garden zoanthids: coral spawn pearl cluster; settled single tiny polyp; juvenile group of THREE button polyps; mature wide colony of many orange-centered violet tentacle-fringed button polyps on small rock. Dead eggs cloudy broken pearls; dead baby/juvenile/adult shriveled collapsed brown SOFT tissue with little dark bare substrate, NEVER white stony cups. No fish eyes.

name: Mushroom coral
brief: Mushroom coral: soft corallimorph spawn pearls; tiny settled single mauve disc; juvenile two small frilled discs; adult three broad overlapping richly textured purple teal mushrooms. Dead states: cloudy failed spawn and progressively collapsed brown wrinkled soft tissue on substrate, NO hard white skeleton, NO tall stalk or terrestrial mushroom gills. No fish eyes.

name: Branching SPS
brief: Branching SPS stony coral: small pink spawn bundle; settled minute single calcifying polyp; juvenile sparse THREE-branched frag; mature complex branching cyan turquoise colony with violet and pale mint tips. Dead eggs cloudy; dead settled baby tiny bare skeleton; dead juvenile exposed gray branch skeleton; dead adult bare cream gray skeleton with no living colored tissue. Dead is not living pale bleaching.

name: Hammer LPS
brief: Hammer LPS stony coral: small pink spawn pearls; baby single tiny settled fleshy polyp on skeletal cup; juvenile two small heads; adult large colony of mint hammer-ended tentacles on purple flesh and branching skeletal bases. Dead spawn cloudy; dead baby empty tiny cup; dead juvenile two bare cups; dead adult exposed gray cream branching skeleton and skeletal ridges, no colorful living tentacles.

name: Soft leather coral
brief: Soft leather coral: coral spawn pearls; settled tiny polyp nub; juvenile small short stalk with few lobes; adult broad lavender pink leather crown on thick stalk with many fine golden polyps. Dead eggs cloudy; dead baby shriveled speck; dead juvenile collapsed dark limp stalk; dead adult fallen wrinkled brown leathery tissue, NO stony white skeleton.
